Priya (PM): dropping a quick prototype for a more discoverable invite flow in org settings. figma: https://figma.redwood/proto/invite-cta 

Priya (PM): two quick questions: 
1) For SSO-on orgs, do we keep the email input disabled with explanation, or remove it entirely and surface only the join-link + manage IdP CTA? 
2) For the roles table, designers want a small 'Activity' affordance that jumps to the audit log. need keyboard plan and telemetry.

Noah (Designer): prefer removing the email field when sso_enforced. show a subtle card: "Invites via your org's SSO" with primary CTA "Copy join link". include micro copy about expiry and a small 'Manage via IdP' link. 

Noah (Designer): for roles, add a compact inline button "Activity" next to role name. it should be a real button (not link) so keyboard users can tab to it quickly. on mobile, put it inside overflow.

Rae (Frontend Eng): agree. implementation notes: client checks org.flags.sso_required. when true, render the SSO card and remove input. announce the change with an aria-live region. Activity -> we should use stable anchors like `#audit-role-<id>` and after scroll set tabindex=-1 then focus. snippet: 
const a = document.getElementById(`audit-role-${id}`);
a.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
a.focus();
a.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'});

Rae (Frontend Eng): also be careful: if anchor not present (audit not loaded), open audit panel and focus first result. fallback to opening audit page in a new tab if desktop and audit offline.

Jon (Backend): backend will expose `POST /orgs/:org_id/invite-link` returning { token, expires_at } if we support TTL. for now we can return token with null expires_at. we'll also add audit entries with `anchor_id` field so frontend can link directly.

Maya (Accessibility): checklist: 
- when input removed, announce new card with aria-live=polite. 
- ensure 'Copy join link' is a button with aria-describedby pointing to a short hint that explains "This link can be shared with users managed by your IdP." 
- Activity button must be reachable in tab order right after role name. set aria-controls to audit region. 
- color contrast: ensure card text >= 4.5:1.

Maya (Accessibility): microcopy suggestion: 
"Invites managed by your organization’s Single Sign-On. Share the join link with members managed by your identity provider."

ci-bot: note: add telemetry keys: invite.method (email|link|idp), invite.link.copied, audit.jump.source=roles_table. please include role_id when emitting audit jumps.

Priya (PM): action items: Noah -> update comps to remove the email field for SSO orgs and add small expiry hint; Rae -> implement anchor/focus pattern and aria-live announcement; Jon -> API for invite link; Maya -> final accessibility checklist. i'll file tickets and tag owners. thanks! :white_check_mark:
